I'll verify the computation by calculating C(53,13) and summing its decimal digits.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Calculate C(53, 13)
n, k = 53, 13
binomial = math.comb(n, k)
print(f"C(53, 13) = {binomial}")

# Get decimal digits
digits = [int(d) for d in str(binomial)]
print(f"Decimal digits: {digits}")

# Sum the digits
digit_sum = sum(digits)
print(f"Sum of decimal digits: {digit_sum}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

ANSWER: 59
